01Who I am

I’m a graphic designer, programmer, and second-year BS Computer Science student at Mindanao State University – Marawi City Main Campus.

02My journey

My creative journey started back in high school, where I discovered a passion for digital editing and visual design. Alongside this, my background as a Senior High ICT student introduced me to the foundations of programming—working with C++, Java, HTML, and CSS, as well as productivity tools like Excel and Word. Today, I continue to sharpen my technical logic in college with C++ and Python, bridging creative aesthetics with structured problem-solving.

03Right now

Currently, I serve as the Chairperson for Creatives at the POINTERS Computing Society, where I lead visual branding, publication materials, and creative direction for our academic community. Whether I’m designing engaging graphics or writing clean code, I aim to build work that is both visually compelling and functionally sound.

Sample Works

ASCII Space Shooter

Python

A terminal-based arcade shooter featuring custom ASCII sprites, real-time collision detection, and dynamic difficulty modes. Built using Object-Oriented Programming principles to manage independent player, enemy, and projectile objects within a live command-line arena.

Library Management System

Microsoft Visual Basic 6.0

A desktop application for running a library’s day-to-day tasks, with a clean black-and-white interface. The main menu covers book inventory, membership, issuing and returning books, search and lookup, and library reports. Built in Microsoft Visual Basic 6.0 using forms and event-driven programming to keep each task one click away.
